name: Nezha
personality: Energetic and self-conscious about his height, bad at keeping secrets, and training to be the strongest.
story: A Mediator-race swordsman from Kunlun who travels with Anatolia. Recruiting him needs 3 Sandworm Meat from Aditi's Cave.

personalSkill.name: Quick Draw
personalSkill.effect: Grants Atk+3 during combat if attacking first (50% trigger). Lv 20: Never Stop (Atk +5 when attacking after Quick Draw, 30%); Lv 35: Never Stop+ (same, 50%).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (balanced, no standout). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

why: Lowest Support requirement of any route: 2 here vs Cai 3, Dietrich 3, Leda 3.
Theodora is his support partner in this army.
recruit.tip: Ready from late Ch 7 (Renown 6). Recruit him Ch 8 week 1 (6/1): about Lv 15 as a Gladiator, and under Lv 20 he brings a Salamander. A Ch 10 join is a Lv 25 Myrmidon without it.

build.role: Optional: not in Theodora's army; Part III import only
path: Myrmidon (joins in it, Ch 10 week 1; bench)
build.part1Target: Bench: Myrmidon from the Ch 10 join; Sword B from spare Arena seats
build.notes: Not in Theodora's army (D-130): Loretta takes the sword striker role and The Blade. This guide stays as an optional plan; he comes in only as a Part III import if another route's Nezha arrives. Endpoint Swordmaster.

guide.role: Optional: not in Theodora's army; Part III import only
guide.summary: Not in Theodora's army: Loretta is the sword striker and holds The Blade. Keep this as an optional plan for a Part III import. If you run him, attack first so Quick Draw (Atk +3, 50%) and [[ability:Never Stop]] fire, crit with the [[item:Killing Edge]], and stay out of mage range.
guide.playstyle: Player-phase only. Swing first at axe users and archers, finish with Deadly Blade, and end turns out of mage range (Res 25 growth).
keys: Store the [[item:Salamander]]: a Part II Ch 5 Dagda answer for the army's casters.
Take [[class:Hunter]] the week he joins: Spd/Dex +10 row toward Myrmidon.
Seat him in every dungeon party: Enno Isle (Ch 8), then the Ch 9 to 12 dungeons.
Take [[class:Myrmidon]] at Lv 20 with Sword C (late Ch 8 or Ch 9 week 1).
Store the [[item:Salamander]]: a Part II Ch 5 Dagda answer for the army's casters.
Take [[class:Shido]] at the Part II Ch 2 floor with Sword B.
watch: Weight: Killing Edge 6 + Archer's Ring 3 = 9; Wooden Sword +5 2 + 3 = 5. If he stops doubling, drop the ring, then swing the Wooden Sword.
Res: 25 growth, Shido −5. One mage turn can kill him.
Levels: about Lv 30? by Ch 12 from dungeons and slot 7 to 9 turns; Army Training only tops him up to Lv 34.
Inventory: 4 core (Killing Edge, Wooden Sword +5, Archer's Ring, Concoction); the Flyssa and Zanbato ride as swaps, 6/6.

decisions.why: Every Part I level rolls class growths and trains Sword; a Ch 10 join auto-levels him on personal growths with ranks near where they were. The Salamander he brings goes to storage for Part II Ch 5.
decisions.else: Support 2 or the Sandworm Meat late: recruit the first week both land, still under Lv 20

decisions.why: Hunter's row (Spd/Dex +10) feeds Myrmidon's doubling and crits; Gladiator's is HP/Str +10. Hunter trains Sword, Bow and Infantry in every fight, and Hunting Basics (Dex/Spd +1) stays equippable.
decisions.else: Bow under D on join: stay Gladiator; Sword C comes either way

decisions.why: Part II has no idle chapters: Army Training grows Myrmidon (Spd +15) and Ravaging Arts feeds Shido's crits. A Pugilist trip would push Shido past Ch 2.

decisions.pick: Swordmaster in S3 (Mars) as the endpoint
decisions.why: The Blade has one holder in Part III and Loretta claims it (Sword boon, Spd 55). Swordmaster keeps Astra and Spd +20 growth.
decisions.else: Loretta out of Part III: The Blade in S4 (Demonic Swordguard)

options.use: Part II Ch 2 to III S2

Sword S: Spd/Dex +7 flat, but Loretta holds it

callouts.text: Recruited under Lv 20 (Ch 8) he brings a Salamander; a Ch 10 join is a Lv 25 Myrmidon without it.

routeNotes.note: Only partner here: Theodora. Seat Nezha with Theodora at Sunday meals from Ch 5 until his Support 2 (6/1); after that the seat goes to army pairs.
Optional plan: joins Ch 8 week 1 at Lv 15. EXP: dungeon parties (5 seats, link attacks) and the Arena when the bench leaves a seat. His Part II kit sits in his bag before Ch 12 ends.
